id: typescript-express-stripe-id-not-bound-to-session
title: Stripe subscription/customer ID from request used in billing call without matching it to the session
summary: 'Controller handlers take `subscriptionId` or `customerId` from `req.query` or `req.body` and
  pass them straight to the identity manager''s Stripe billing calls. Nothing checks that the ID belongs
  to the caller''s active organization. Any authenticated user can read or modify another tenant''s subscription,
  seats, plan or customer payment data (IDOR / broken access control). The tenant request guards module
  also lacked a Stripe-ID-to-session guard, which this rule flags as well.

  '

- CWE-862

rule:
  message: 'Stripe identifier handling is not bound to the authenticated session. Either a billing call
    receives a request-supplied ID without a prior `assertStripeIdMatchesSession(requestedId, sessionId)`
    check, or the tenant guards module has no such guard defined.

    '
  pattern-either:
  - patterns:
    - pattern: $IM.$M(...)
    - metavariable-regex:
        metavariable: $M
        regex: ^(getAdditionalSeatsQuantity|getCustomerWithDefaultSource|getAdditionalSeatsProration|getPlanProration|updateAdditionalSeats|updateSubscriptionPlan)$
    - pattern-not-inside: 'assertStripeIdMatchesSession(...)

        ...

        '
  - patterns:
    - pattern: "function userMayManageOrgUsers(...) {\n  ...\n}\n"
    - pattern-not-inside: "function assertStripeIdMatchesSession(...) {\n  ...\n}\n...\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'Before calling the identity manager with a subscription or customer ID taken from the request,
    verify it equals the ID stored on the authenticated session user for the active organization, and
    reject with 403 otherwise. Use the `assertStripeIdMatchesSession` guard from `enterprise/utils/tenantRequestGuards`.
    Better still, derive the ID from `req.user` and ignore client-supplied values.

    '
  example: "export function assertStripeIdMatchesSession(requestedId: string, activeId: string | undefined):\
    \ void {\n    if (!activeId || requestedId !== activeId) {\n        throw new InternalFlowiseError(StatusCodes.FORBIDDEN,\
    \ GeneralErrorMessage.FORBIDDEN)\n    }\n}\n\n// in the controller\nconst { subscriptionId } = req.query\n\
    assertStripeIdMatchesSession(subscriptionId as string, req.user?.activeOrganizationSubscriptionId)\n\
    const result = await identityManager.getAdditionalSeatsQuantity(subscriptionId as string)\n"
